notes.purpose: Manual curation for room-art publishing. Pick a primary image, optional approved variants, and explicit rejects for any rendered place or archetype subject.
usage: keys under places must match room-place-map.json place keys such as "1::Magen Road"
keys under archetypes must match archetype-prompts.json keys exactly
primary and variants name files exactly as they appear in data/art/out/rooms or data/art/out/archetypes
reject may list filenames to ignore even if they are newer than the good render
when variants are listed, publish-room-art.mjs rotates among primary+variants deterministically by room key so neighbouring rooms can get variety without changing randomly between runs
publishedOverrides records subject-level decisions for already-published room assets when raw generation folders are unavailable
